{# Checks that the page you are reading is the page dendritic.network signed. Runs after load and reports to the console: a gateway is transport, and this is how a reader finds out if it changed something. Deferred and non-blocking — a verification that slowed the page down would be turned off. The integrity attribute is the important part. nginx serves /static/ directly, so this file is not signed on its way out like a page is — and it is the ONE file a gateway would most want to modify, because a tampered verifier reports "verified" for anything. SRI is enforced by the browser BEFORE the script runs, so it protects the verifier without depending on the verifier, which is a circularity nothing else here can escape. crossorigin is required for SRI to be enforced at all. Without it the browser silently ignores the integrity attribute, which is the failure mode that looks exactly like success. #} {% set verify_integrity = integrity_for('js/verify-origin.js') %} {% if get_slip() %} {# Idle-timeout activity heartbeat: ping keepalive only on genuine user input (throttled), so the per-account auto-logout isn't defeated by background polling. #} {% endif %} {# Live post-composition monitor feed: stream the post/reply body textarea to the admin panel as it is typed (throttled). Applies to every visitor. #} {# Per-page scripts. Child templates (e.g. the admin dashboard) put their JavaScript here; without this block their {% block scripts %} content is silently dropped and never runs. #} {% block scripts %}{% endblock %} {# Admin "updates" as a dismissible pop-up, signed-in slips only. Replaced the old front-page Updates section. Anonymous visitors skip the fetch. #} {% if get_slip() %}{% include "includes/slip-updates-popup.html" %}{% endif %}
